scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:web && pnpm run lint:docs
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:api && pnpm run check:ext
scripts.check:playwright: bash -lc 'mkdir -p output/playwright && trap "pnpm exec playwright-cli close >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" EXIT && pnpm exec playwright-cli open http://web:3000 && pnpm exec playwright-cli snapshot >/dev/null && pnpm exec playwright-cli screenshot --filename=output/playwright/home.png'
